# Reference-model parity fixtures

30 real `.ifc` files (10 domains × IFC2X3/IFC4/IFC4X3_ADD2), vendored verbatim from
buildingSMART International's own `Certification-datasets` repository
(`github.com/buildingSMART/Certification-datasets`, `Simple-Scene` folder under each
schema, downloaded 2026-09-25) for the reference-model parity testing plan — see
`planning/ifcopenshell-ts/80-reference-parity-testing-plan.md`.

Copyright © buildingSMART International Ltd. Licensed under
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.txt) — attribution
required, no other restriction. This directory's structure:

```
<schema>/<domain>.ifc            -- the real reference file, unmodified
<schema>/<domain>.golden.json    -- normalized dump, generated by tools/reference_dump_python.py
                                     against a real installed ifcopenshell-python (SS4 of the plan
                                     doc). Regenerate only when the fixture set changes or a real
                                     upstream Python behavior change is confirmed -- never as part
                                     of routine test runs.
```

Golden dump format: one JSON object per instance, keyed by STEP id, holding its type name
and forward attributes as a positional array (schema-declaration order). Entity
references are `"#<id>"` strings, never nested. See the plan doc's §4 for the full
format spec and rationale.
